archetype.revealSubtitle: Based on your interests and personality
archetype.explorerDesc: You are reflective, creative and seek emotional depth. Your inner world is rich and full of nuances. You see what others overlook and find beauty in complexity.
archetype.explorerTip: Your superpower is introspection. Lumen will help you channel that depth into personal growth.
archetype.warriorDesc: You are energetic, action-oriented and determined. You face challenges head-on and don't give up easily. Your discipline is your greatest weapon.
archetype.warriorTip: Your superpower is resilience. Lumen will boost your mental strength with challenges tailored to you.
archetype.socialDesc: You are empathetic, connected and care about others. Your energy comes from human relationships and you know how to make everyone feel welcome.
archetype.socialTip: Your superpower is connection. Lumen will help you maintain healthy relationships while taking care of yourself.
archetype.sageDesc: You are calm, analytical and seek balance in everything. Your inner peace is contagious and you are an anchor for those around you.
archetype.sageTip: Your superpower is serenity. Lumen will deepen your path towards inner harmony.
archetype.freeSpiritDesc: You are spontaneous, curious and a lover of change. Every day is a new adventure and your optimism lights up any room.
archetype.freeSpiritTip: Your superpower is freedom. Lumen will be your adventure companion in emotional growth.

0.text: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it outside.
0.author: Buda

1.text: You do not have to control everything. Sometimes you only need to let go.
1.author: Lumen

2.text: Every day is a new opportunity to be kinder to yourself.
2.author: Lumen

3.text: Vulnerability is not weakness. It is the greatest measure of courage.
3.author: Brené Brown

4.text: Your mind is a garden. Your thoughts are the seeds.
4.author: Lumen

5.text: It is not the load that breaks you down, it is how you carry it.
5.author: Lou Holtz

6.text: Breathe. You are exactly where you need to be.
6.author: Lumen

7.text: Happiness is not the absence of problems, but the ability to deal with them.
7.author: Steve Maraboli

8.text: Today you deserve your own kindness as much as anyone else does.
8.author: Lumen

9.text: Self-care is not selfish. You cannot serve from an empty cup.
9.author: Eleanor Brownn

10.text: Emotions are like waves. Watch them come and go.
10.author: Lumen

11.text: One small step today is a giant leap for your wellbeing.
11.author: Lumen

12.text: You do not have to be perfect to deserve love and acceptance.
12.author: Lumen

13.text: Gratitude turns what you have into enough.
13.author: Melody Beattie

14.text: Your worth does not decrease because someone cannot see your light.
14.author: Lumen

15.text: It is okay not to be okay. What matters is not staying there.
15.author: Lumen

16.text: Calm is a superpower in a world full of noise.
16.author: Lumen

17.text: Do not compare your chapter 1 to someone else’s chapter 20.
17.author: Lumen

18.text: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
18.author: Lumen

19.text: The best relationship you can have is the one you have with yourself.
19.author: Diane Von Furstenberg

20.text: Choose compassion today. Start with yourself.
20.author: Lumen

21.text: Rest is not giving up. It is getting ready to continue.
21.author: Lumen

22.text: You do not need a reason to deserve inner peace.
22.author: Lumen

23.text: Every breath is a chance to begin again.
23.author: Lumen

24.text: Your mental health is a priority, not a luxury.
24.author: Lumen

25.text: Today's small victories are tomorrow's great achievements.
25.author: Lumen

26.text: Allow yourself to feel. Emotions are not your enemy.
26.author: Lumen

27.text: What nourishes your soul is never a waste of time.
27.author: Lumen

28.text: You are not your thoughts. You are the one who observes them.
28.author: Eckhart Tolle

29.text: Today is a good day to take care of yourself.
29.author: Lumen

30.text: True strength appears in moments of vulnerability.
30.author: Lumen
